home.subtitle: Take a quiet moment for yourself today.
home.introBody: Ask a question, draw cards, and see what they point to. Your readings stay on this phone.
home.unlockHint: Locked spreads open free with a short ad, or all at once with Premium.
home.startHint: New to tarot? Start with Card of the Day or a one-card reading. There's no required order; pick any spread.
home.dailyTap: Tap the card to reveal today's message
home.signEmptyBody: In Burmese tradition, the day of the week you were born on has its own animal, planet and direction. Discover yours, just for fun.
home.chartBody: See your Sun, Moon and Rising sign.
home.chartSampleBody: A sample wheel. Add your birth date to see your own Sun, Moon and Rising sign.
home.chartNudgeBody: Add your birth date to see your Sun, Moon and Rising sign.

library.title: Card Library
library.subtitle: {{total}} cards. Tap a card to read its meaning.
library.noResultsBody: Try another word, in English or Burmese.

card.promptNote: Every card shows a likely direction, not a fixed fate. Hard cards often point to change or something worth your attention.
card.notFoundBody: This card isn't in the deck.

reading.questionPlaceholder: For example: What should I focus on this week?
reading.questionHint: Open questions work best: ask “how” or “what” rather than yes or no.
reading.shuffleHint: Take a slow breath and keep your question in mind.
reading.pickTitle: Tap the cards that call to you. {{remaining}} to go.
reading.revealTitle: Tap each card to turn it over

summary.majorsMany: Several Major Arcana cards appeared: expect a meaningful chapter with bigger lessons in it.
summary.majorsNone: No Major Arcana appeared: expect everyday territory, shaped mostly by your own choices.
summary.suitWands: Wands lead this reading: expect energy, drive and creative fire to be at the centre.
summary.suitCups: Cups lead this reading: expect feelings, relationships and intuition to take centre stage.
summary.suitSwords: Swords lead this reading: expect thoughts, decisions and honest words to take centre stage.
summary.suitPentacles: Pentacles lead this reading: expect work, money and everyday practical matters to take centre stage.
summary.reversedMany: Many cards are reversed: expect energy to turn inward, or things to take longer than you hope. Go gently.
summary.allUpright: Every card is upright: expect energy to flow openly.
summary.advice: What to keep in mind as this unfolds: {{advice}}

intro.love: Here is what the cards foresee for love and relationships:
intro.career: Here is what the cards foresee for your work and path:
intro.money: Here is what the cards suggest for money and resources:
intro.health: Here is what the cards suggest for your wellbeing and inner life:

love.cups: Cups lead: expect feelings and connection to take centre stage in your love life.
love.wands: Wands lead: expect passion and desire to drive your love life, so take care it does not burn too fast.
love.swords: Swords lead: honest words and clear thinking will matter most in matters of the heart.
love.pentacles: Pentacles lead: expect stability and commitment, shown through everyday actions.

career.cups: Cups lead: how work feels to you, and your relationships there, will take centre stage.
career.wands: Wands lead: expect drive, ambition and new initiatives in your work.
career.swords: Swords lead: expect decisions, communication and clear strategy to shape your work.
career.pentacles: Pentacles lead: expect craft, steady effort and tangible results in your work.

money.cups: Cups lead: feelings about money, and spending driven by emotion, are likely to be in focus.
money.wands: Wands lead: new ventures and income-generating energy are likely to appear.
money.swords: Swords lead: clear thinking, planning and honest accounting will matter for your money.
money.pentacles: Pentacles lead: expect material security, savings and practical foundations to take centre stage.

health.cups: Cups lead: emotional wellbeing and inner nourishment are likely to be in focus.
health.wands: Wands lead: vitality, and how you spend your energy, are likely to be in focus.
health.swords: Swords lead: a busy mind and its effect on rest are likely to be in focus.
health.pentacles: Pentacles lead: your body, routines and grounding habits are likely to be in focus.

adviceTopic.love: For your heart, what to keep in mind: {{advice}}
adviceTopic.career: For your work, what to keep in mind: {{advice}}
adviceTopic.money: For your finances, what to keep in mind: {{advice}}
adviceTopic.health: For your wellbeing, what to keep in mind: {{advice}}

reading.crisisTitle: You don't have to face this alone
reading.crisisBody: It sounds like you may be going through something very painful. A tarot reading isn't the right support for this moment. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local health professional. If you might be in danger right now, contact your local emergency number.
reading.resumeBody: You started this spread and didn't finish. Pick up where you left off, or start fresh.

answer.title: Your answer

intro.yesno: You asked a yes-or-no question, so here is the way the cards point.
intro.when: You asked about timing, so here is the pace the cards foresee. It is a sense of rhythm, not an exact date.
intro.open: Here is what the cards foresee for your question.

verdict.yes: Yes: the cards flow in your favor, and the way ahead looks fairly open.
verdict.leaningYes: Likely yes, with a few things to handle along the way.
verdict.unclear: Too early to say: the cards are mixed, so your own choices will tip the balance.
verdict.leaningNo: Likely no in its current form: expect obstacles you will need to deal with first.
verdict.no: Not for now: the cards point to resistance, so expect to need a different approach or more time.

timing.wands: Expect things to move fast, within days to a few weeks.
timing.swords: Expect quick movement, driven by decisions and conversations, within weeks.
timing.cups: Expect the pace of feelings: weeks to a few months.
timing.pentacles: Expect slow, steady progress, over months or longer.
timing.major: This looks like a turning point more than a fixed date. Expect it to arrive once the lesson has landed.

answer.delayed: Several cards are reversed: expect some delay, or some inner work, first.
answer.keyCard: The card that speaks most to your question is {{card}}{{reversed}}: {{text}}
answer.disclaimer: For entertainment only: the cards describe likely paths, not certainties. The choice is always yours.
answer.healthNote: For questions about health, the cards cannot predict an outcome. Please speak to a health professional for real answers.

reading.topicSuggest: This sounds like a “{{topic}}” question. Use that topic?

astro.sun: This card belongs to your Sun sign, {{sign}}, so today it speaks straight to you: expect it to touch something personal.
astro.moon: This card belongs to your Moon sign, {{sign}}: expect your feelings and inner life to be in focus today.

astro.elementSun: Its {{element}} energy matches your Sun sign, {{sign}}. Today will feel like familiar ground, and what you already know will serve you well.
astro.elementDominant: {{element}} runs strongest in your birth chart, so this card’s energy will feel natural to you today.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Draw a card, pause, and see what your day may bring. $t(appName) works offline, and everything you write stays on your phone.
onboarding.aboutBody: Everything here is optional and stays on your phone. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.signHint: A Burmese tradition, just for fun. Used for your weekday sign on the Home screen.
onboarding.reminderHint: A gentle morning nudge to see your Card of the Day. You can change the time in Settings.
onboarding.birthDateHint: Gives you your Burmese weekday sign (a tradition, just for fun) now, and lets us build your birth chart next.
onboarding.dateExample: The faded numbers are only examples of the format.
onboarding.dateInvalid: That date doesn't look right. Check it, or skip this for now.
onboarding.chartBody: Your birth time and place give you a Rising sign and houses. If you don't know the time, you can still see your Sun and Moon. Stays on your phone.
onboarding.chartSampleNote: This wheel is only a sample. Yours is calculated from the details below.

settings.burmeseNumerals: Use Burmese numerals (၀၁၂၃၄၅၆၇၈၉)
settings.previewText: Today is a good day to listen to your heart.
settings.shareAppMessage: Mingalar Tarot, a gentle tarot companion for daily readings. {{url}}
settings.reversedCardsHint: Cards can appear upside down, adding nuance to their meaning.
settings.reminderHint: A gentle nudge to see your Card of the Day. The card itself stays a surprise.
settings.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for this app. You can allow them in your phone's settings.
settings.name: Name
settings.nameHint: Used only to greet you on the Home screen.
settings.soundHint: Soft sounds when shuffling and turning cards.
settings.dataHint: Your journal and settings are stored on this phone.
settings.exportFailed: Couldn't export your data. Please try again.
settings.importHint: Adds readings from a file you exported earlier. Nothing on this phone is deleted or replaced by older copies.
settings.importNothing: Nothing new to add. Those readings are already here.
settings.importNewer: That backup was made by a newer version of the app. Please update and try again.

settings.importFailed: Couldn't restore that file. Please try again.
settings.deleteDataBody: This removes every reading and note, your name, your weekday sign, lesson progress and settings from this phone. It can't be undone. You may want to export your data first.
settings.deleteDataCloud: You'll also be signed out of cloud backup. Your cloud copy stays until you delete it under Cloud backup.
settings.analyticsHint: Anonymous counts of which features are used, and crash reports, help us improve the app. Never your readings, questions, notes, name or birth details.

disclaimer.short: For entertainment only. Tarot shows likely paths, not certainties.
disclaimer.long: $t(appName) is made for entertainment. The cards describe likely directions, not guaranteed outcomes, and are not a substitute for professional advice about health, money, legal or personal matters. You are always the one who decides what is right for your life.

sign.title: Weekday signs
sign.subtitle: A Burmese tradition, shared for fun and reflection.
sign.choose: Choose the weekday you were born
sign.wednesdayHint: Born on a Wednesday? Before noon is Wednesday; from noon onwards is Rahu.
sign.findByDate: Not sure? Work it out from your birth date
sign.afternoonHint: Only matters for Wednesday births: noon onwards counts as Rahu.
sign.dateResult: You were born on a {{weekday}}. Your sign is now selected.
sign.dateInvalid: That date doesn't look right. Please check the day, month and year.
sign.disclaimer: Weekday signs are a cultural tradition shared for entertainment. They don't describe your health, money or future.

about.title: About $t(appName)
about.body: $t(appName) is a calm, bilingual tarot companion for English and Burmese readers. Draw a card, read its meaning, and write down what it brings to mind.
about.artBody: The card illustrations are the original Rider–Waite–Smith artwork drawn by Pamela Colman Smith and published in {{year}}. They are in the public domain.
about.wordsBody: All card meanings, lessons and weekday sign texts were written especially for $t(appName), in English and Burmese.
about.chartBody: Planet positions are calculated on your phone with the open-source astronomy-engine library. City names, coordinates and time zones come from GeoNames (geonames.org), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution {{version}}.

sync.title: Cloud backup
sync.intro: Optional. Back up your journal, settings and Card of the Day history so you can restore them on a new phone. Your name stays on this phone.
sync.codeSent: We sent a sign-in code to {{email}}. It may take a minute to arrive.
sync.signOut: Turn off backup on this phone
sync.deleteBody: Your account and every reading stored in the cloud will be deleted. Readings on this phone stay here. This can't be undone.
sync.deleted: Your cloud account has been deleted

guide.title: Help me choose
guide.subtitle: Answer one question and we'll suggest a reading. There is no wrong answer.
guide.question: What are you hoping for?
guide.quickHint: One card, a minute or two.
guide.unfoldHint: Past, present and future in three cards.
guide.situationHint: What is happening, what is in the way, and what may help.

guide.tip: Cards point to likely paths, not fixed fates. Take what feels useful and leave the rest.
